fact: Taxpayers registering with the legal and tax authorities are assigned a unique identifier in addition to their NCC, allocated to nearly 175,000 enterprises, but the system is not yet functional pending IT modifications; in the Abidjan region registration with the RCCM and the tax authorities is a single procedure at the CEPICI one-stop shop.
title: Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Tax Purposes: Côte d'Ivoire 2025 (Second Round, Combined Review)
publisher: OECD Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Tax Purposes
